# WildJobs

> WildTeam's conservation jobs directory at https://jobs.wildteam.org.uk/.

WildJobs brings together vacancies from public job feeds. Each job card links to the original advert, where candidates can check the full details and apply. WildJobs does not host individual job-detail pages or accept applications.

Job summaries, sectors and course suggestions may be assisted by AI. The original advert is the authoritative source for requirements, salary, eligibility, location, application instructions and closing dates. Listings change as sources update and adverts expire; use the current directory rather than a cached vacancy list.

Saving jobs requires no account. Shortlists are stored on the visitor's browser only and do not sync across devices. Public registration is currently closed.

Sector and career guides combine cited careers sources with a clearly described sample of directory adverts. Written guidance requires editorial approval; job counts and qualifying salary samples update separately. Pages labelled “Guide preview” await that approval and are excluded from the sitemap. Salary figures describe advertised starting pay in the stated sample, not the whole market. Sample employer pages remain illustrative design previews and are not evidence about real employers. Use the sitemap to identify reviewed guides intended for search indexing.

## Public references

- [Current conservation jobs](https://jobs.wildteam.org.uk/): Search and filter the current directory, then follow the original advert.
- [Career areas](https://jobs.wildteam.org.uk/careers): Explore sectors using current vacancies.
- [Employers](https://jobs.wildteam.org.uk/employers): Organisations represented by current directory listings.
- [How we use AI](https://jobs.wildteam.org.uk/how-we-use-ai): Explanation of AI-assisted summaries, sectors and training suggestions.
- [Sitemap](https://jobs.wildteam.org.uk/sitemap.xml): Public directory URLs intended for search indexing.
